page_text_ocr_zh: 早晨，当青蛙弗洛格起床的时候，他马上感觉这世界有些不对劲，有什么变了。
page_text_en: In the morning, when Frog Floppy got up, he immediately felt something was wrong with the world—something had changed.
summary_zh: 弗洛格早晨起床，感觉世界有些不对劲，似乎发生了变化。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他走到窗前，非常惊讶地看到每样东西都完全变白了。
page_text_en: He walked to the window and was very surprised to see that everything had turned completely white.
summary_zh: 弗洛格走到窗前，惊讶地发现外面的一切都被白雪覆盖，世界完全变白了。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他困惑地冲出房门，到处都是雪，脚下很滑。突然，他摔倒了……
page_text_en: He rushed out of the door in confusion. Everywhere was covered in snow, and the ground was very slippery. Suddenly, he fell down...
summary_zh: 弗洛格困惑地冲出房门，发现到处都是雪，脚下很滑，突然摔倒了。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他一路滑到河边，再滑入河中。河水结了冰，弗洛格躺在冰冷坚硬的冰上。“没有水我怎么洗澡呀？”青蛙惊慌地想。
page_text_en: He slid all the way to the riverbank, then slipped into the river. The river water had frozen, and Frog lay on the cold, hard ice. "How can I take a bath without water?" the frog thought in panic.
summary_zh: 弗洛格滑入结冰的河中，躺在冰面上，因无法洗澡而感到惊慌。

page_text_ocr_zh: 他坐在河边冷得发抖。小鸭脚踩冰刀鞋飞快地溜了过来。“嗨，弗洛格！”她说，“天气这么好，我们一起溜冰吧。”
page_text_en: He sat by the river, shivering from the cold. The little duck, wearing ice skates, glided over quickly. "Hi, Frog!" she said, "The weather is so nice, let's go skating together!"
summary_zh: 弗洛格坐在河边发抖，小鸭滑冰经过并邀请他一起溜冰。

page_text_ocr_zh: “不，我快冻僵了。”弗洛格回答道。“可是溜冰对你有好处，”小鸭说，“我来教你。”
page_text_en: "No, I'm almost frozen," Frog replied. "But skating is good for you," said Duck. "I'll teach you."
summary_zh: 弗洛格因寒冷而发抖，小鸭看到后主动提出教他溜冰，以帮助他适应寒冷的冬天。

page_text_ocr_zh: 小鸭将冰刀和围巾给了弗洛格，然后自己在后面推他。弗洛格飞快地滑过冰面，但很快就跌倒了。“你不觉得好玩吗？”小鸭问。可是弗洛格的牙齿一直在打颤，他几乎冻僵了。
page_text_en: The little duck gave the ice skates and scarf to Frog, then pushed him from behind. Frog skated quickly across the ice, but soon fell down. “Don’t you think it’s fun?” asked the little duck. But Frog’s teeth were chattering, and he was almost frozen stiff.
summary_zh: 小鸭教弗洛格溜冰，弗洛格虽然滑得很快但很快摔倒，因寒冷而牙齿打颤，几乎冻僵。

page_text_ocr_zh: “你有一件温暖的羽毛外套，而我只是一只光秃秃的小青蛙。”他说。“啊，你说得对。你就留着这条围巾吧，我要走了。”小鸭说。
page_text_en: "You have a warm feather coat, and I'm just a bare little frog," he said. "Ah, you're right. Keep this scarf, I'm going now," said the duck.
summary_zh: 小鸭看到弗洛格在寒冷中发抖，主动提出让他留下自己的围巾，并准备离开。弗洛格因寒冷而感到不适，小鸭的举动体现了对朋友的关心。

page_text_ocr_zh: 过了一会儿，小猪背着一篓木柴走来。“你不冷吗？”弗洛格问小猪。“不冷啊！”小猪说，“我很喜欢这种新鲜、健康的空气。冬天是最美丽的季节。”
page_text_en: After a while, Piglet came walking by, carrying a basket of firewood. "Aren't you cold?" Frog asked Piglet. "Not at all!" Piglet said, "I love this fresh, healthy air. Winter is the most beautiful season."
summary_zh: 小猪背着木柴来到弗洛格面前，弗洛格问他是否冷，小猪表示自己不冷，并说喜欢冬天新鲜健康的空气，认为冬天是最美丽的季节。

page_text_en: "You have a layer of fat that can keep you warm, but I have nothing," said Frog. "Poor Frog!" thought Pig, "I really hope I can help him."
summary_zh: 弗洛格在雪地里发抖，小猪背着木柴路过，看到弗洛格的困境，心里感到同情，希望能帮助他。

学会关爱别人

每个人都会有需要别人帮助的时候，因为每个人都会有自己的问题。人们之间的互相关爱使生活变得更美好。

想一想
1. 大雪纷飞，青蛙觉得很冷，可为什么朋友们都不怕冷呢？
2. 青蛙倒在了雪地里，朋友们是怎么帮助他的？
3. 穿上了新毛衣后，青蛙觉得怎么样？

试一试
你周围的人有谁需要你的帮助吗？请你用自己的方法关爱他（她）吧！
page_text_en:
Learn to Care for Others

Everyone will have times when they need help from others, because everyone has their own problems. Mutual care between people makes life better.

Think About It
1. When it's snowing heavily, Frog feels very cold. Why aren't his friends afraid of the cold?
2. When Frog fell in the snow, how did his friends help him?
3. How did Frog feel after putting on his new sweater?

Try It
Is there anyone around you who needs your help? Please care for them (her) in your own way!
summary_zh: 本页是绘本的总结与互动页，标题为“学会关爱别人”，通过三个思考题引导孩子回顾故事内容，并鼓励他们思考如何在现实生活中关爱他人。

The author, Max Velthuijs, is a highly acclaimed children's illustrator internationally.
This series has won the Dutch Golden Pencil Award, the French Prix de Treize Award,
the German Bestlist Award, and the American Graphic Award.

“These warm, humorous picture books, with touching illustrations, clear stories, and deep meaning, will be enjoyed by both parents and children.”
— The Sunday Telegraph, UK

This is a series of psychological education stories that help children's emotional growth. Each story naturally reveals an important theme and is full of imagination. Both text and illustrations are created by Max Velthuijs. The text is lively and subtly humorous, while the illustrations feature a unique simple-line style, hailed by Western artists as 'a masterpiece of line drawing.' The series has been translated into 38 languages and has sold over a million copies worldwide.
